question.text:
System1 Group's Test Your Ad shows each new UK TV ad to a nationally representative sample of UK adults, measures their second-by-second emotional response and publishes a Star Rating from 1.0 to 5.9 stars (one decimal) that predicts the ad's long-term brand-building potential. What Star Rating will System1 publish for the following UK Christmas 2026 ad? Ad description:
Brand: Aldi (UK)
Ad title: Aldi Christmas Advert 2026 | Will it be a paw-fect Christmas?
Released: 5 November 2026 (brand online release; TV debut scheduled 5 November)
Length of the main edit: 50 seconds (a 30-second cut-down is also published)
Format: CGI
Setting: Snowy pine forest above a lit village at night; a candlelit dinner table at the end.
Characters: Kevin the Carrot (recurring brand character); his daughter Chantenay; Cauli Dog, the family's cauliflower pet (from the previous year's campaign); a scarecrow dressed as Santa. Celebrity voices: not stated.
Story:
1. Chantenay, in a fur-hooded coat, holds a "LOST CAULI-DOG" poster beside a red "Letters to Santa" post box and wishes for Cauli Dog's return.
2. Kevin and Chantenay follow a trail of small paw prints into the snowy forest at night.
3. They come upon a scarecrow dressed as Santa, wrapped in fairy lights.
4. Whether they bring Cauli Dog home for Christmas Day: not stated.
5. The film closes on a table of Christmas food.
Music: not stated.
Dialogue and voiceover: not stated.
Tone: magical, heartfelt
Brand and product presence: The Aldi logo appears on a title card reading "Kevin the Carrot and the Christmas Wish" and on the end card. The end card shows a dinner spread with the line "ALL YOU WANT FOR CHRISTMAS".
